title: Letter from Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy to Abraham Mendelssohn-Bartholdy, 1829-05-08
subject: Concerts–England–London; Moscheles, Ignaz, 1794-1870; Sontag, Henriette, 1806-1854; Malibran, Maria, 1808-1836
descrption: Mendelssohn reports to his family about his time in London. A plaster cast was made of his head, he attended a concert where Moscheles performed and met the singers Henriette Sontag and Maria Malibran.
